title: Ramp
description: Fintech clarity: a white page with warm light-grey panels, warm near-black ink with a 60% 'hushed' grey for two-tone headlines, hairline borders and 12px corners. One loud acid lime-yellow on the main buttons, a near-black footer. A single-weight neo-grotesk and IBM Plex Mono counters.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling built from the footer's near-black
Instrument Sans stands in for Lausanne (closed); IBM Plex Mono is the original's own mono
